rationale: Section 338 still unused; Greer (Jun 17) says it suits 'discrete circumstances' while broad action goes via 301/122 (122 expires Jul 24), so long-standing discriminators like China or Brazil (already under 301) stand out.
Islamabad MoU clause 5 has Iran demining and dialoguing with Oman on Hormuz; the June 23 Oman-Iran joint working group makes Oman the natural joint partner.
No UN member has followed the US on Golan (Wikipedia Jun 14); only US-aligned, pro-Israel small states are plausible in 2026, so weights stay skeptical.

Caroline Bezengi (Cameroon-flagged, sanctioned) was last tracked in Red Sea/Gulf of Aden en route India; no onshore contamination confirmed yet, so coastal states along that route dominate if landfall occurs.

Treasury's Economic Fury campaign targets shadow banking and foreign facilitators, but few big Iranian banks remain undesignated; Jun 5 action cited ties to Tejarat, Mellat and Pasargad, making Tejarat/Kunlun-type targets most plausible.
Perim/Mayun is held by Tareq Saleh's National Resistance with UAE backing (Intelligence Online Apr 2026: UAE most active on the island); Houthis contest Bab al-Mandeb but show no possession.

US Space Command (Apr 2026) assesses Russia is operationalizing co-orbital Nivelir ASATs; explicit orbital-weapon acknowledgment by any government is rare, so Russia leads with meaningful uncertainty.
Sudan is the defining 2026 humanitarian catastrophe with a Berlin 'Joint Call' and explicit calls for a Sudanese-owned political process.
Houthis threaten Red Sea shipping after the Jun 17 MoU and Saudi Arabia has been appealing to partners; reporting would most plausibly name a mediator/counterpart (US, Qatar, Oman or China).
Met Police has two full files at CPS (Mutabaruka and Bajinya reported as advanced), with other named suspects as backups.

Tisza's two-thirds majority is targeting Orban-era ministers over procurement/embezzlement; former justice minister Judit Varga, ex-FM Szijjártó and ex-energy minister Lantos are plausible targets, but a September vote is uncertain.
67 signatories as of May 7; reaching 75 by late September needs ~8 more signings, and any non-signing space-emerging state could be 75th, so weights are spread.
Israel revoked PA representatives' visas after Palestinian-state recognition (Australia, Aug 2025); France, the UK and Canada are the most likely Foreign Ministry targets in September 2026.
